blockTypeNote: Two-column layout: left intro panel + right list of text cards. Modeled as columns block (left cell = intro text+CTA, right cell = stacked insight cards). No images.
designContext: White section, row gap 64px, padding 80px. LeftPanel w480 gap 24px: heading 'Latest Insights' (Inter extrabold 36px/44px #1a1a2e), desc (Inter normal 16px/19px #666677), outlined orange CTA (border 2px #ff6b00, px28 py14 rounded 4px, text #ff6b00 bold 16px 'View All Resources'). RightCardsList gap 20px: 2 insight cards. Each card: col gap 12px, padding 24px, rounded 8px, bg #f5f5f5, border 1px #e5e7eb. CardMeta row: tag (Inter bold 12px #003da5 uppercase) + dot + read time (Inter normal 12px #666677). Title (Inter bold 20px/24px #1a1a2e). Desc (Inter normal 14px/17px #666677).
